scope.summary: Implement pattern (regex) styles: apply a character style automatically to every regular-expression match inside paragraphs carrying a paragraph style. Implement nested styles: apply character styles through or up-to N occurrences of a delimiter (character, word, tab, or end-nested-style marker) inside a paragraph, plus per-line nested line styles. Both are paragraph-style-embedded rules resolved at composition time by the TextEngine (14.7); stored on the paragraph style record in StudioStyleRegistry.
acceptance_criteria: regex pattern styles + nested styles (delimiter N-occurrence + per-line) resolve at composition, stored on paragraph style
expected_tests: live: regex/pattern style auto-applies a character style to every match at composition
test: nested style through/up-to N delimiter occurrences + per-line nested line styles resolve correctly

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Pattern & nested styles

risk_if_missed: No automatic run-level styling; manual character styling of repeated patterns is error-prone.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
